description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'AbstractIndexerTest' for testing the 'AbstractIndexer' class in the SuiteCRM search indexing module. It includes test methods for constructor, getters/setters, adding modules, retrieving documentifier and indexer names, and logger setup.

classes.name: AbstractIndexerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AbstractIndexer class methods and behaviors.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Tests that the indexer mock is an instance of AbstractIndexer.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Verifies getter and setter methods of the indexer, including differential indexing flag, documentifier object, and modules to index.

methods.name: testAddModulesToIndex
methods.description: Tests adding modules to the indexer and handles invalid argument exceptions.

methods.name: testGetDocumentifierName
methods.description: Ensures that the correct documentifier name is returned based on the set documentifier.

methods.name: testGetIndexerName
methods.description: Validates that the indexer name matches the mock's name.

methods.name: testLogger
methods.description: Sets up and verifies the logger instance in the indexer.

methods.name: getIndexerMock
methods.description: Creates a mocked partial instance of AbstractIndexer for testing purposes.
